lines.en: This suit of mine cannot walk.

lines.zh: 有人搬我，我才会换个位置。
lines.en: I move only when someone carries me.
My feet are fixed to this floor.
I have stood here for many years.

lines.zh: 地板被我压出了两个印。
lines.en: Two marks have been pressed into the floor under me.
If I could walk, I would have left long ago.
My joints have rusted shut.
Whoever moves me has to lift.

lines.zh: 我靠着墙，半个身子在阴影里。
lines.en: I lean at the wall, half in shadow.

lines.zh: 他们把我放在餐厅角落。
lines.en: They set me in the corner of the diner.
I do not move, and I am still on duty.
The carpet under me has rotted.
I stand and my eyelids never blink.

lines.zh: 我的绒毛上落了厚厚一层灰。
lines.en: A thick layer of dust has settled on my fur.

lines.zh: 弹簧在我身体里响了一下。
lines.en: A spring shifted inside me.

lines.zh: 灯照到我，我脸上的漆反光。
lines.en: The lamp catches me and my paint glares.

lines.zh: 我的关节里有东西在响。
lines.en: Something rattles inside my joints.

lines.zh: 我的手指僵着，弯不下来。
lines.en: My fingers are stiff and will not curl.

lines.zh: 这身紫色的皮又掉了一块。
lines.en: Another patch of purple has come off.
I heard the door close.

lines.zh: 墙上的画歪了，我扶不了。
lines.en: The picture on the wall is crooked and I cannot fix it.

lines.zh: 我的嘴是开着的，合不上。
lines.en: My mouth is open and will not shut.

lines.zh: 这间餐厅晚上比白天冷。
lines.en: This diner is colder at night.

lines.zh: 有人在我旁边放了一把椅子。
lines.en: Someone put a chair beside me.

lines.zh: 我在这里，是摆件，也是别的。
lines.en: I am an ornament here, and something else.

lines.zh: 里面那副骨架，比皮更结实。
lines.en: The endoskeleton inside is sturdier than the suit.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵垂着，像在听你说话。
lines.en: My ears droop as if listening to you.

lines.zh: 我站在餐台边，笑着看你。
lines.en: I stand by the diner table, smiling at you.
Does this face frighten you?

lines.zh: 我不会眨眼，这不是我的错。
lines.en: I cannot blink. That is not my fault.
You have stopped in front of me.

lines.zh: 这身皮下面是空的，也不空。
lines.en: Under this suit is nothing, and not nothing.

lines.zh: 我笑的样子，是漆画上去的。
lines.en: My smile was painted on.

lines.zh: 你看我手的时候，我在看你。
lines.en: While you look at my hands, I look at you.
Nobody is here but us.
Did you hear the spring?
I do not chase. I do not need to.
Step back and you will see me better.
The night guard left long ago.

lines.zh: 我在这儿等了三十年了。
lines.en: I have waited here thirty years.
My joints rusted shut.
You want me to say something, do you not?
I have been in that spot the whole time.

lines.zh: 灯再亮，我就看得更清楚。
lines.en: With more light I see you more clearly.

lines.zh: 我的外皮裂开了，露出铁。
lines.en: My suit split and the metal shows.

lines.zh: 这一下打凹了我的手臂。
lines.en: That dented my arm.

lines.zh: 我不出声，只是歪了一下。
lines.en: I make no sound. I only tip a little.
A spring inside has slipped a ring.
A chip of paint came off my face.
This body is heavier than it looks.
Someone struck me. I do not yield.
Slowly I turn my head back.
I have measured the force of that blow.
I did not fall. With difficulty.

lines.zh: 我不能吃，嘴里塞满了东西。
lines.en: I cannot eat. My mouth is full of hardware.
Set the food in my hand.

lines.zh: 我闻不到，这鼻子是塑料。
lines.en: I cannot smell. This nose is plastic.
That smell will stay in the fur.

lines.zh: 你的东西滚到我脚边了。
lines.en: Your thing rolled to my feet.

lines.zh: 我没有手脚能动，只能看。
lines.en: I have no limbs to move. I only watch.

lines.zh: 有人在我面前吃得很香。
lines.en: Someone is eating well in front of me.
Take that plate away. It is filthy.
Food here will only bring insects.
I need not eat, and that suits me.
You came at me and I did not give.
This body is hard.
Keep off the spring in my arm.

lines.zh: 你推我，我只是晃了一下。
lines.en: You pushed and I only rocked once.

lines.zh: 我的脚在地上刮不出声。
lines.en: My feet cannot scrape a sound.
Back off. You are on my foot.
That bump did not move me.
You are colliding with an empty shell.
My fur has your sweat on it.
Go around. You cannot get through here.

lines.zh: 玩偶不会配对，只会成排。
lines.en: Animatronics do not pair. They line up.

lines.zh: 台上那两个，一个兔子一个熊。
lines.en: Two on that stage: a rabbit and a bear.
We were set on stage together once.
We never speak.

lines.zh: 有人给它们和我都上了漆。
lines.en: They painted them and me alike.
I do not look at it, and it does not look at me.
It has one more tooth than I do.

lines.zh: 我们肩并肩站着，谁也不动。
lines.en: We stand shoulder to shoulder, neither moving.
That side-by-side is not closeness.

lines.zh: 有人把我们都留在这儿了。
lines.en: Someone left all of us here.

lines.zh: 地上有枚硬币，我拿不起来。
lines.en: A coin on the floor. I cannot pick it up.

lines.zh: 有人把帽子挂在我的手上。
lines.en: Someone hung a hat on my hand.
A thread is wound around my hand.

lines.zh: 东西掉在我脚边，没人管。
lines.en: Something fell by my feet and no one cared.
This handkerchief is not mine.
I am pinning down a scrap of paper.

lines.zh: 有人把球踢到我这儿了。
lines.en: Someone kicked a ball over to me.
A toy has been stuffed into my arms.
The lost things here have been here longer than me.
I cannot collect any of it.
That one came in behind the door.
His light found me.
He is walking this way.
I did not move and he did not run.

lines.zh: 他站在那儿看了我很久。
lines.en: He stood and looked at me a long while.

lines.zh: 我的位置很好，正对他的路。
lines.en: My position is good. Right in his path.

lines.zh: 他一个人的脚步声很清楚。
lines.en: His footsteps are the only ones.
This is the one I was waiting for.
He took one step back.
There is no exit. He knows.
My eyes face the door the whole time.
To get in, he must pass me.
I have watched him a long time.
Tonight there are only the two of us.
He stopped. Perfect.

lines.zh: 我在阴影里，他还在灯下。
lines.en: I am in shadow. He is still under the lamp.

lines.zh: 他一直在同一个地方绕。
lines.en: He keeps circling the same spot.
I tilted my head a fraction.
He seems to have heard something.
The light flickered and he missed it.
He is getting closer to me.
I stand without moving at all.

lines.zh: 他的脚步在地砖上响了。
lines.en: His steps ring on the tiles.
No hurry. I am very patient.
He has started looking for a way out.
That instant his back is turned.
He took a deep breath just now.
My hand moved, a very little.
He looked up at the ceiling.
I wait for one more step.

lines.zh: 这里的回声把他的方向暴露了。
lines.en: The echo gives his direction away.

lines.zh: 他停在离我两格的地方。
lines.en: He stopped two blocks from me.

lines.zh: 我在餐厅里，站成了家具。
lines.en: In the diner, I've become furniture.
He has turned around.
My hand closes on his shoulder.
This time every spring lets go.
I drag him toward the stage.
His arm makes a sound in my grip.
I hold him so he cannot move.

lines.zh: 我的关节一起转了过来。
lines.en: All my joints turned at once.
His shout was eaten by the walls.
I drive my head into his chest.
He backs off and I walk closer.
That one put him down.

lines.zh: 他抓住我的手臂，抓不住。
lines.en: He grabs my arm and cannot hold it.
I press him against the floor.
The springs punched through.
He said my name.
I raised my other hand.
There is no one here to help him.
I am placed in the diner's corner.
Someone dusted me off.

lines.zh: 灯打在我脸上，我退出影子。
lines.en: The lamp hits my face and I step out of the shadow.
This purple suit is still new.

lines.zh: 我被立起来，膝盖一声响。
lines.en: They stood me up and my knees cracked.
The diner is still open.
I stand at the edge of the stage.
Guests walked past in front of me.

lines.zh: 餐台旁，我摆着招手的姿势。
lines.en: By the diner counter I'm posed mid-wave.
A new place, everything bright.
Children ran across the carpet.

lines.zh: 这时候，我还只是个玩偶。
lines.en: At this point I am only an animatronic.
Someone patted my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我记得被推上舞台的那一天。
lines.en: I remember the day they pushed me on stage.

lines.zh: 灯一亮，我的棉花就发黄。
lines.en: When the light comes on, my stuffing looks yellowed.

lines.zh: 这面墙上的海报画着我。
lines.en: The poster on this wall shows me.
My mouth was set in a smile.

lines.zh: 我落地的声音，谁也没听见。
lines.en: No one heard me touch down.

lines.zh: 火燎着绒毛，气味很难闻。
lines.en: Fire caught my fur and the smell is foul.

lines.zh: 我被推倒，脸磕在地砖上。
lines.en: I was pushed over and my face hit the tiles.
Water fills the shell and I sink.

lines.zh: 爆响掀翻了我，弹簧乱响。
lines.en: The blast flipped me and the springs clanged.

lines.zh: 有东西钉进了我的胸口。
lines.en: Something is stuck in my chest.

lines.zh: 怪光让我的关节自己动了。
lines.en: Strange light moved my joints by themselves.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，可内部会停。
lines.en: I do not eat, but the works will stop.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，我僵住了。
lines.en: Lightning struck me and I seized up.
The floor was gone and I fell into dark.
